6.name: TEXT_REGGYR3VIRANILYA_00396_NISHA_000_011
6.description: We are born of Sri Lakshmi, the Lady of Blisss. She created us in Her image, and in the doing imparted to us great giftsss.

8.description: Ananta are born from eggs, and as we shed our ssskin, our scales only grow more lustrousss and brilliant. It is one of the sssecrets to our everlasssting beauty.
